title: AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24077v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to follow natural-language instructions, yet still fail frequently in closed-loop flight. Correcting these failures requires repairs, i.e., actions that avoid them at the states the policy itself reaches, which human pilots cannot label at scale and rule-based planners cannot supply reliably. In this paper, we present AeroRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework in which an aerial navigation policy iteratively learns from its own failures. Our key insight is that a failing policy should judge its own repairs by flying on from them. Judged in this way, its sampled actions and even rule-based proposals that hurt it when imitated directly become reliable supervision. translated_title: AeroRSI：面向航空视觉-语言导航的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使无人机（UAV）能够遵循自然语言指令，但在闭环飞行中仍然频繁失败。纠正这些失败需要“修复”，即在策略自身到达的状态下避免失败的动作，而人类飞行员无法大规模标注这类数据，基于规则的规划器也无法可靠地提供。在本文中，我们提出了AeroRSI，这是一个递归自我改进框架，其中航空导航策略从自身的失败中迭代学习。我们的关键洞察是：一个失败的策略应当通过从修复动作出发继续飞行来评判这些修复。以这种方式评判时，其采样的动作、甚至那些直接模仿时会对其造成伤害的基于规则的提议，都能成为可靠的监督信号。此外，一个回合会在首次失败时终止，从而掩盖后续的失败，直到先前的失败被修复。因此，AeroRSI在每一轮都更新其监督信号，将失败锚定于……（原文在此截断）
tldr: AeroRSI提出了一种递归自我改进框架，让航空视觉-语言导航策略通过“从修复动作出发继续飞行”来自我评判修复质量，从而将自身失败乃至规则提议转化为可靠监督信号，并在每一轮迭代中不断更新监督以修复隐藏的后续失败。
en_tdlr: AeroRSI introduces a recursive self-improvement framework in which an aerial vision-language navigation policy judges its own repairs by flying onward from them, turning its failures and even rule-based proposals into reliable supervision that is renewed every round.
